info.title: Decoupling the Research-Development-Loop Skill Chain from the Superpowers Plugin

abstract.para: The Research-Development-Loop (RDL) skill chain is decoupled from the third-party Superpowers plugin: its six phases no longer invoke any external plugin skill as a required step, and the chain runs to completion with the plugin absent. Each idiosyncratic dependency is replaced by a verified industry standard, and the plugin is retained as a credited reference implementation. Two self-referential defects surfaced during scholarly review — a discretionary deferral loophole and an undeclared Phase-5 toolchain — and both were repaired in the chain itself.
